name: media_folders
description: An organizational media folder with a stable ID, display name, immutable company/branch ownership and optional parent. It never names a filesystem directory or changes media object storage.
lifecycle: Created with owning-scope upload authority. Renamed or moved with an observed version; parent and child have the same scope, with acyclic trees limited to 12 levels. Only an empty folder can be removed; its hidden row remains for audit. Non-purged assets, including archived and trashed items, prevent removal. Parent versions advance when direct contents change.

columns.Meaning: Immutable company owner and tenant key.
Immutable branch owner, also inherited by child folders and uploaded assets.
columns.Null meaning: Company-owned metadata shared with members who can view company media.

columns.Meaning: Parent folder of the same company and scope; changed by an atomic library move.
columns.Null meaning: A root folder in this owning scope.

columns.Meaning: Member-chosen display label, never used as a storage path. Duplicate labels are allowed and stable IDs distinguish folders.
Membership that created this folder or independent copied folder.
PostgreSQL-clock last metadata or direct-content change; version is the concurrency token.
PostgreSQL-clock removal instant of an empty folder; the audit row remains.
columns.Null meaning: The folder is active and may be browsed.

columns.Meaning: Positive optimistic concurrency token, incremented for metadata and direct-content changes.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, branch_id) REFERENCES branches(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: An optional owning branch belongs to the same company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id) REFERENCES companies(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The folder belongs to an existing company.
Tenant key used by folder, asset and audit references.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, parent_id) REFERENCES media_folders(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The parent belongs to the same company; application tree locks enforce scope equality, cycles and depth.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, created_by_membership_id) REFERENCES memberships(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The creating membership belongs to this company.
Display labels contain visible text within the name bound and exclude controls.
A folder cannot directly parent itself.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX media_folders_company_created_idx ON public.media_folders USING btree (company_id, created_at)
constraints.Purpose: Counts active folders and per-UTC-day creations behind admission limits.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX media_folders_parent_name_idx ON public.media_folders USING btree (company_id, parent_id, name, id)
constraints.Purpose: Browses folder children in stable name/ID order.
